mapper.select: SELECT ITEM_ID FROM RENT WHERE RENT_ID = #{rentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE BOOK_ITEM SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE ITEM_ID = #{itemId}
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, BOOK_ID, RESERVATION_ID FROM RESERVATION WHERE BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND STATUS = '예약진행중' ORDER BY RESERVATION_DATE ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
SELECT ITEM_ID FROM BOOK_ITEM WHERE STATUS = '대여가능' AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE RESERVATION SET STATUS = '대출완료' WHERE STATUS = '예약진행중' AND RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RENT (USER_ID, ITEM_ID, DUE_DATE) VALUES (#{userId}, #{itemId}, SYSDATE+7)
mapper.select: SELECT b.TITLE, bi.ITEM_ID, u.NAME, u.USER_ID, TRUNC(SYSDATE - r.DUE_DATE) DELAY_DAYS FROM RENT r JOIN BOOK_ITEM bi ON r.ITEM_ID = bi.ITEM_ID JOIN BOOK b ON b.BOOK_ID = bi.BOOK_ID JOIN USERS u ON r.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE SYSDATE > r.DUE_DATE AND bi.STATUS = '대여중'
